shots.content: Fair creator in glasses and green kurta on a terrace, touching her cheek and talking at a phone camera.
shots.note: L1 (rewritten) 'My skin looked dull every single morning.' MEERA's dull, matte BEFORE face as B-roll, with a small sigh and a touch to her cheek. Opens on a face.

shots.content: AI colour wheel sketched in a notebook with a lavender swatch (wrong: blue opposite yellow).
shots.note: Client 00003291 'colour wheel is off, yellow is opposite purple not blue'. Correct animated wheel full-screen: purple exactly opposite yellow, an arrow between them, and yellow neutralising on 'helps cancel yellow-looking dullness' (rewritten L2).

shots.content: Tube dispensing a lavender blob onto the back of a hand from a nozzle-like tip.
shots.note: L3 'Now watch it blend.' S3+S4+S5 (5.6-10.6 = 5.0 s) = ONE PS08 clip at real speed. Here clip 0-1.33 s: lavender stripe on MEERA's dusky hand, with no tube in frame.

shots.content: Two hands on a wooden ledge, with a thick lavender smear on one.
shots.note: L4 'It starts lavender, then blends completely clear.' PS08 clip 1.33-3.2 s: fingertips rub and the lavender visibly disappears.

shots.content: Two hands side by side after 'blending', with no visible difference.
shots.note: Client 00003290 'product is not blended, there has to be difference shown after mixing'. PS08 clip 3.2-5.0 s: fully blended, with no cast or residue, and the treated patch looks visibly more even and radiant. Under L5 'Zero white cast, zero purple residue'.

shots.content: Creator with large lavender patches on forehead and cheeks, hands on face, with BEFORE/AFTER labels at 12.8-13.95.
shots.note: L6 'made for Indian skin, 4% niacinamide...'. Two library clips: PS04_dot_face clip 0-1.4 s (neat small dots), then PS05_blend_glow clip 2.7-5.0 s (cream melts in invisibly -> dewy Instant Glow, smile). Remove the mid-shot BEFORE/AFTER labels; the B/A moves to the end.

shots.content: Creator in an SPF bubble holding the tube, eyes closed, on the terrace.
shots.note: L7 'SPF 50 PA+++ gives me the daily protection I actually need.' (14.34-17.92). Use PS02 14.3-17.95 (3.65 s): MEERA lifts the exact capped tube and smiles. Keep the SPF super. From 17.95 cut to the B/A split (see S8), so the last 1.1 s of this slot becomes the split.

shots.content: Packshot of the tube standing next to its box.
shots.note: Client 00003289 'remove this'. Drop the packshot.
